purpose.en: Relax your lower back and glutes.

text.zh: 呼气时把膝盖轻轻拉向胸口
text.en: As you breathe out, gently pull your knees to your chest

text.zh: 双手抱住膝盖下方，头和肩放松贴地。
text.en: Hold just below your knees and keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.

text.zh: 吸气时手松一点，让膝盖回离。
text.en: As you breathe in, loosen your grip and let your knees drift out.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the head and shoulders off the mat.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时放松，只拉到舒服的程度
cautions.en: If anything hurts, ease off and stretch only to a comfortable point.

changes: 动画是 8 秒 2 次「呼气抱紧-停 1.3 s-吸气放松」在重复，剂量从 40 秒计时改为 2 组×8 次（rep_hold），dose mode time→reps
英文名 Supine 改 Lying；结束口令按 0.7 s 缩为「放松」
flags: 原为 40 秒放松计时，现按动画（跟呼吸一抱一松）改为计次；若更想按时间放松请定
